CAS_CONTRACT.atomic_unit: single journal record update including state, revision increment, revision_token, observed fields, and timestamps

executor_race.two_executors_see_PREPARED: both read same journal_id revision N; only one CAS PREPARED->APPLYING with expected revision N succeeds; loser gets CAS conflict and observes current durable state
executor_race.lost_update_prevention: per_record RLock or atomic compare-and-swap in file-backed store; no global lock; independent journal_ids do not contend
executor_race.stale_revision_transition: stale journal_rev or stale state expected vs current fails closed with StaleJournalRevisionError; no overwrite

store_methods: create_prepared(record: JournalRecord) -> JournalRecord with revision=1 token
cas_transition(journal_id, expected_revision, expected_state, new_state, observed_digest, observed_revision, evidence) -> (success bool, current record)
scan_requiring_recovery() -> list[JournalRecord] where state in (PREPARED, APPLYING, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, RECONCILING)

ordering_enforcement.PREPARED_before_APPLYING_before_external: cas_transition PREPARED->APPLYING must succeed durably before port mutate may be called; can_perform_external_attempt guard rechecked after CAS
ordering_enforcement.terminal_no_outgoing: VERIFIED/VERIFIED_RECOVERED/FAILED_NO_EFFECT/RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT/CONFLICT have no outgoing via is_valid_transition; store rejects CAS from terminal
